meaning:
1) straightness, uprightness
1a) straightness, evenness (moral implications)
1b) rightness, uprightness
1c) what is right, what is due

elsewhere.note: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God…
As for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded…
I know also, my God, that you try the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these…
How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,
The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
